## Session Context (iptv-org TV)

Curated free linear TV over the iptv-org static API: one `iptv` portmanteau tool (12 ops).

**Before starting work:**
1. Learn the cache shape: iptv(operation="facets")
2. Find channels: iptv(operation="search_channels", query="<name>", country="<CC>")

**At end of work:**
- Rebuild affected playlists: iptv(operation="build_playlist", country="<CC>")
- Quote kept/excluded counts; never promise a stream is alive without probe=true
